_meta.description: High-resolution micro-step funnels for business scenarios

side_hustle_to_fulltime.name: Side Hustle to Full-Time
side_hustle_to_fulltime.description: Transition from day job + side hustle to full-time entrepreneur
side_hustle_to_fulltime.entry_point: Person with stable employment starts earning on the side

stages.label: Tell spouse/partner about the plan
stages.source: Fidelity Couples & Money 2023 — 43% fight about money

stages.label: First month full-time on own business
Reach previous salary level
stages.source: MBO Partners 2024 — 50% match prior income by year 2

stages.label: Exceed previous salary
stages.source: MBO Partners 2024 — 35% earn more than employment

stages.label: Sustained — never return to employment
stages.source: Zapier 2024 — 40% return to employment within 18 months

flipping_reselling.name: Flipping & Reselling
flipping_reselling.description: Buy low sell high — thrift stores, retail arbitrage, eBay, Poshmark, Mercari
flipping_reselling.entry_point: Person discovers reselling through social media or personal experience

stages.label: Visit first thrift store or garage sale
stages.source: ThredUp Resale Report 2024 — 40% of consumers have thrifted

stages.label: Wait for first sale (patience test)
stages.source: eBay Seller Hub 2024 — avg 2 weeks for first sale

stages.label: First sale!
stages.source: Mercari Seller Survey 2023 — 80% sell within 30 days if priced right

stages.label: Learn pricing, margins, and what sells
Invest $200 in inventory
stages.source: estimated — requires confidence from first sales

stages.label: Reach $1,000/month revenue
stages.source: Poshmark Seller Stats 2024 — top 15% of active sellers

stages.label: Handle returns, scams, and problem buyers
stages.source: eBay 2024 — 8-12% return rate, INAD fraud common

stages.label: Hire helper or automate (crosslisting tools)
stages.source: List Perfectly 2023 — 25% of power sellers use automation

stages.label: Open own store or warehouse
stages.source: NARTS 2023 — 8% of resellers go full retail

tutoring_teaching.name: Tutoring & Teaching Business
tutoring_teaching.description: Start a tutoring or teaching business, online or local, and scale beyond 1-on-1
tutoring_teaching.entry_point: Person with subject expertise decides to monetize their knowledge

stages.label: Have deep knowledge in a subject
Sign up on Wyzant/Preply/iTalki or post locally
Set hourly rate ($20-60 starting)
stages.source: Wyzant 2024 — avg new tutor starts at $25-40/hr

stages.label: Get first student inquiry
stages.source: Preply Tutor Insights 2024 — avg 2-3 weeks for first booking

stages.label: Get positive review
stages.source: Wyzant 2024 — 80% of students leave reviews if prompted

stages.label: Raise rates based on reviews and demand
stages.source: Preply 2024 — avg 20-30% rate increase after 50 sessions

stages.label: Reach $2,000/month
stages.source: Preply 2024 — top 20% of tutors, avg 15 hrs/week

stages.label: Create group classes (3-8 students)
stages.source: Outschool 2024 — 30% of teachers offer group format

stages.label: Build strong reputation and referral network
stages.source: Tutoring.org 2023 — 60% of established tutors get referrals

stages.label: Create online course (Udemy, Teachable, own site)
stages.source: Udemy 2024 — 97% of courses earn under $1K lifetime

stages.label: Reach $10,000/month
stages.source: Teachable 2024 — top 1% of course creators, requires course revenue

sources: Global Private Tutoring Market Report — Technavio 2024

print_on_demand.name: Print on Demand
print_on_demand.description: Start a print-on-demand business via Printful, Merch by Amazon, Redbubble, Etsy
print_on_demand.entry_point: Person sees POD success stories and decides to try design-based passive income

stages.label: See POD success videos/posts
stages.source: baseline — millions of POD tutorials online

stages.label: Create first 10 designs
stages.source: Merch Informer 2024 — 50% of applicants never upload

stages.label: Wait for marketplace indexing (patience test)
stages.source: Merch by Amazon 2024 — avg 6-12 weeks for organic visibility

stages.label: Get first sale
stages.source: Merch Informer 2024 — 65% of sellers with <50 designs get zero sales in 6 months

stages.label: Analyze which designs sell and why
Create 50 more designs based on data
stages.source: estimated — many quit after low initial sales

stages.label: Reach $100/month
stages.source: eRank 2024 — only 30% of Etsy POD sellers earn $100+/mo

stages.label: Learn Etsy SEO / Amazon keyword optimization
stages.source: eRank 2024 — SEO is #1 growth lever for POD

stages.label: Reach $1,000/month
stages.source: Merch Informer 2024 — top 5-10% of all POD sellers

stages.label: Create brand identity around top-selling niche
Reach $5,000/month
stages.source: Merch Informer 2024 — top 1-2%, requires 1000+ designs or strong brand

inherited_family_business.name: Inherited Family Business
inherited_family_business.description: Take over and grow a family business across generations
inherited_family_business.entry_point: Child grows up around the family business and faces the succession question

stages.label: Grow up around the family business
Work in business part-time (summers, weekends)
stages.source: PwC Family Business Survey 2023 — 70% of next-gen work in business before deciding

stages.label: Decision: join the family business or not
stages.source: PwC 2023 — 55% of next-gen intend to join

stages.label: Join business full-time
stages.source: Deloitte Next Gen Survey 2024 — of those who decide, 75% actually join

stages.label: Face resistance from founder/senior generation
stages.source: Deloitte 2024 — 80% report generational conflict on strategy

stages.label: Formalize ownership/leadership transition
stages.source: PwC 2023 — only 34% have documented succession plans

stages.label: Navigate family politics, sibling rivalry, emotional baggage
stages.source: FFI 2023 — #1 cause of failure is family conflict

stages.label: Become official owner/CEO
stages.source: PwC 2023 — 30% of family businesses survive to 2nd gen

stages.label: Implement modern systems (tech, processes, accounting)
stages.source: KPMG 2024 — 65% of successful transitions include digital transformation

stages.label: Retain key employees through transition
stages.source: Deloitte 2024 — 45% of key staff leave during transitions

stages.label: Grow revenue beyond parent's peak level
stages.source: FFI 2023 — 40% of 2nd gen grow the business

stages.label: Sustain through full generational shift (business survives 10+ years under new leadership)
stages.source: FFI 2023 — only 12% make it to 3rd gen, so 50% of 2nd gen survivors fail before 3rd

sources: Family Firm Institute (FFI) Global Data Points 2023
Harvard Business Review — Family Business Succession Studies
